description:
What happens when a hurricane meets a tornado? An early hurricane season creates chaos in Tornado Alley as Tropical Storm Cristobel makes landfall during tornado season. Professional storm chasers, Reed Timmer and Mike Theiss, race to capture valuable data from the dangerous new climate regime that seems to be taking hold.
